concepts/vehicle-routing-with-synchroniz.title: Vehicle Routing with Synchronization Constraints (VRPMS)
concepts/vehicle-routing-with-synchroniz.summary: VRPMS couples route design with temporal synchronization windows between service layers, requiring specialized repair and feasibility handling.

concepts/dag-topological-sort-scheduling.title: DAG Topological-Sort Move Evaluation for Synchronized Schedules
concepts/dag-topological-sort-scheduling.summary: Represent a synchronized schedule as a DAG, repair arcs on insertion, re-topologically sort in O(|V|+|E|) and replay to get exact makespan cost for every candidate move.

concepts/swarm-intelligence-pso-aco.md.title: Swarm Intelligence: PSO, ACO, and Emergent Coordination
concepts/swarm-intelligence-pso-aco.md.summary: Swarm Intelligence as the handbook defines it: simple agents, local interaction, no central control, and the PSO family from canonical velocity updates to rotation-invariant SPSO-2011.

concepts/variable-neighborhood-search.md.title: Variable Neighborhood Search (VNS)
concepts/variable-neighborhood-search.md.summary: VNS systematically changes neighborhood structures during search; key variants include VND, RVNS, and BVNS with shake-and-descent cycles.

concepts/parallel-metaheuristics-coopera.title: Parallel Metaheuristics and Cooperative Search
concepts/parallel-metaheuristics-coopera.summary: Parallel metaheuristics run multiple search processes; cooperative variants exchange information to improve robustness and solution quality over independent runs.

concepts/disjunctive-scheduling-constrai.title: Disjunctive Scheduling Constraint-Programming Model
concepts/disjunctive-scheduling-constrai.summary: Interval variables, sequences and cumul functions express scheduling with capacity coupling; encoding choice dominates, with disjunctive evidence from JSP, HFSP and premarshalling papers.

concepts/multi-objective-metaheuristic-t.title: Multi-Objective Metaheuristic Tuning and Front Validation
concepts/multi-objective-metaheuristic-t.summary: Taguchi S/N tuning of metaheuristic factors plus an epsilon-constraint ground truth and six front metrics; the direction convention of composite metrics decides the conclusion.

concepts/k-multi-visit-drone-routing-pro.title: k-Multi-Visit Drone Routing Problem (k-MVDRP)
concepts/k-multi-visit-drone-routing-pro.summary: k-MVDRP models a truck with k reusable drones under payload-dependent energy limits and operation-level synchronization, optimized for minimum completion time.

concepts/min-cost-parallel-drone-schedul.title: Min-cost Parallel Drone Scheduling VRP (PDSVRP)
concepts/min-cost-parallel-drone-schedul.summary: PDSVRP minimizes total truck+drone operating cost with multiple trucks and parallel drones under capacity and time constraints.

concepts/nonlinear-drone-energy-function.title: Nonlinear Drone Energy Function in Routing
concepts/nonlinear-drone-energy-function.summary: Models payload-aware convex drone energy and extends routing formulations to arbitrary energy functions while preserving tractable optimization structure.

concepts/cumulative-volume-lower-bound-c.title: Cumulative Volume Lower Bound Search
concepts/cumulative-volume-lower-bound-c.summary: Inventory balance turned into a cumulative lower bound on shipped volume; tightening the allowed loss term phase by phase lets CP search reach good solutions fast.

concepts/cash-based-operating-profitabil.title: Cash-Based Operating Profitability
concepts/cash-based-operating-profitabil.summary: Profitability signal based on cash-flow components; Thai cash-flow evidence (Kakinuma) and accrual-heavy ASEAN OP results (Kim & Hoang) refine its cross-market boundaries.

concepts/peukert-law-battery-discharge.m.title: Peukert's Law for Drone Battery Discharge (Current-Dependent Usable Capacity)
concepts/peukert-law-battery-discharge.m.summary: Peukert's law makes usable battery capacity shrink with discharge current: C_d = Σ I_i(I_i/I_nom)^(p-1)Δt_i with p=1.1, gated by I_max per phase and C_d ≥ 0.9·C_nom.

concepts/auxiliary-decision-variable-mod.title: Auxiliary Decision Variables in Scheduling Model Strengthening
concepts/auxiliary-decision-variable-mod.summary: Scheduling evidence that adding auxiliary decision variables changes solver performance in ways model size cannot predict, and that strengthening strategies do not transfer between CP and MIP.

concepts/branch-and-price-column-generat.title: Branch-and-Price Column Generation
concepts/branch-and-price-column-generat.summary: Exact optimization paradigm that solves huge integer programs by generating columns on demand inside branch-and-bound while preserving decomposition structure.

concepts/metaheuristic-hybridization.md.title: Metaheuristic Hybridization Classes
concepts/metaheuristic-hybridization.md.summary: Handbook Ch. 12 taxonomy of metaheuristic hybrids by four criteria, plus two working patterns: exact solution merging, and relaxation-guided search.

concepts/pdsvrp-c.md.title: PDSVRP-c (Parallel Drone Scheduling Vehicle Routing Problem with Collective Drones)
concepts/pdsvrp-c.md.summary: PDSVRP-c: multiple trucks plus collaborative drone missions with min-makespan and synchronization; introduced by Montemanni et al. 2024 with CP and MILP models.

concepts/maritime-routing-under-uncertai.title: Maritime Routing Under Uncertainty
concepts/maritime-routing-under-uncertai.summary: A planning-level concept for uncertainty in maritime routing, spanning demand, travel time, fuel and disruption risk, plus robust and rolling-horizon mitigation strategies.

concepts/drone-speed-selection-in-routin.title: Drone Speed Selection in Truck-Drone Routing
concepts/drone-speed-selection-in-routin.summary: Treats drone speed as an explicit optimization variable, balancing delivery speed against energy range and synchronization costs in truck-drone routes.

concepts/copula-opinion-pooling.md.title: Copula Opinion Pooling (COP)
concepts/copula-opinion-pooling.md.summary: COP updates a non-normal prior market to subjective marginal views by pooling each view's cdf with the prior-implied cdf and inheriting the prior copula for the joint posterior.

concepts/drone-swarm-synchronization.md.title: Drone Swarm Synchronization
concepts/drone-swarm-synchronization.md.summary: Swarm synchronization: drones couple and decouple at nodes, serve over-capacity customers with simultaneous arrival, split delivery, detours, multi trips; defined by DRP-SS (Li, Wang & Zhan 2024).

concepts/predictive-to-prescriptive-anal.title: Predictive-to-Prescriptive Analytics
concepts/predictive-to-prescriptive-anal.summary: Framework that uses contextual features to optimize decisions directly and evaluates value against data-poor baselines, with optional bootstrap-based robustness.

concepts/generative-adversarial-imitatio.title: Generative Adversarial Self-Imitation Learning (GASIL)
concepts/generative-adversarial-imitatio.summary: Adversarial self-imitation: discriminate the agent's own top-K past trajectories; the discriminator reward r − alpha·log D added to the policy gradient fixes sparse-reward credit assignment.

concepts/plate-cut-position-guillotine-m.title: Plate-and-Cut-Position Guillotine MIP
concepts/plate-cut-position-guillotine-m.summary: Modeling guillotine cutting by a variable per plate-and-cut-position pair, so every feasible guillotine cut is in the model, and pricing the pool by LP duals keeps it solvable.

concepts/parallel-drone-scheduling-trave.title: Parallel Drone Scheduling Traveling Salesman Problem (PDSTSP)
concepts/parallel-drone-scheduling-trave.summary: Truck-and-parallel-drone routing minimizing makespan via giant-tour split, MILP/DP, local search; collective-drone variant PDSTSP-c extends it.

concepts/black-litterman-view-blending.m.title: Black-Litterman View Blending
concepts/black-litterman-view-blending.m.summary: Bayesian blending of CAPM-implied equilibrium returns with investor views: optimal portfolio is equilibrium weights plus confidence-weighted view tilts; confidence can be implied or user-specified.

concepts/transformer-seq2seq-routing-sol.title: Transformer Sequence-to-Sequence Routing Solver
concepts/transformer-seq2seq-routing-sol.summary: An encoder-decoder neural policy that builds a routing solution node by node with masked attention and state-aware queries, trained by REINFORCE, giving near-MIP quality at millisecond inference.

concepts/maritime-inventory-routing-prob.title: Maritime Inventory Routing Problem
concepts/maritime-inventory-routing-prob.summary: Defines integrated maritime planning where ship routing/scheduling and port inventory dynamics are optimized jointly, plus common extension patterns used in industrial shipping models.

concepts/payload-induced-drone-battery-c.title: Payload-induced Drone Battery Consumption Rate (BCR)
concepts/payload-induced-drone-battery-c.summary: Battery draw grows with payload in drone delivery, and this dependency should be modeled explicitly in feasibility and scheduling decisions.

concepts/negative-book-equity-style-clas.title: Negative-Book-Equity Style Classification
concepts/negative-book-equity-style-clas.summary: Approach for assigning negative-book-equity firms into value-growth style groups so factor portfolios retain information usually lost by standard book-to-market screens.

concepts/collective-drone-delivery.md.title: Collective Drone Delivery (Coupled Drones as One Vehicle)
concepts/collective-drone-delivery.md.summary: Coupling k depot drones into one c-drone pools payload and range; eligibility splits requests at 0.81/6.91/10.82 kg, gains average 23.47% and need 12+ drones.

concepts/green-vehicle-routing-problem-t.title: Green Vehicle Routing Problem Taxonomy
concepts/green-vehicle-routing-problem-t.summary: Structured map of Green-VRP variants by vehicle technology, objective type, operational scenario, and solver family for comparing environmental-routing models.

concepts/large-neighborhood-ship-pair-de.title: Large Neighborhood Ship-Pair Destroy and Repair
concepts/large-neighborhood-ship-pair-de.summary: Destroy all voyage arcs of two ships, repair by re-solving the MIP with others fixed; metric pair selection cuts subproblems and CPU by geometric means 1.68x/1.22x vs random pairs.

concepts/ratio-hierarchy-for-profitabili.title: Hierarchical Ratio System for Profitability and Growth
concepts/ratio-hierarchy-for-profitabili.summary: ROCE's seven drivers (Sales PM, ATO, Other Items, FLEV, NBC, OLLEV, MSR) and growth's three (Sales, ATO, FLEV) form a hierarchy: lower ratios are finer info about higher ones.

concepts/fuzzy-weighted-max-min-scalariz.title: Fuzzy Weighted Max-Min Scalarization for Multi-Objective MIP
concepts/fuzzy-weighted-max-min-scalariz.summary: Scalarize several objectives by maximizing a weighted minimum of fuzzy membership values, so one MIP solve per weight vector traces out a Pareto approximation without an evolutionary algorithm.

concepts/min-cost-tsp-with-drone.md.title: Min-cost TSP with Drone (min-cost TSP-D)
concepts/min-cost-tsp-with-drone.md.summary: A TSP-D variant that optimizes transportation and synchronization waiting costs, exposing trade-offs between route cost quality, delivery time, and drone usage frequency.

concepts/cp-sat-hint-start.md.title: CP-SAT Hint-Start for Truck-and-Drone Routing
concepts/cp-sat-hint-start.md.summary: A warm-start pattern where a truck-only VRP solution is injected as CP-SAT hints, improving bound quality and final solutions in collaborative drone routing models.

concepts/large-neighborhood-search.md.title: Large Neighborhood Search (LNS)
concepts/large-neighborhood-search.md.summary: LNS improves solutions by repeatedly destroying and repairing large parts of a solution; ALNS adapts operator choice based on observed performance.

concepts/annual-lng-delivery-program.md.title: Annual LNG Delivery Program (ADP)
concepts/annual-lng-delivery-program.md.summary: Tactical LNG planning problem that coordinates inventory, vessel schedules, contract obligations, and optional spot-market actions over annual horizons.

concepts/multirotor-power-model-componen.title: Multirotor Power Model Components (Induced, Profile, Parasite)
concepts/multirotor-power-model-componen.summary: Three-component steady-state power model for multi-rotors: induced (actuator disk), profile (blade element), parasite (body drag); convex T^{3/2} hover law; parameters identified from bench flights.

concepts/tabu-search.md.title: Tabu Search
concepts/tabu-search.md.summary: Tabu Search is a memory-augmented local search method that allows non-improving moves while using tabu tenure and aspiration to escape local optima.

concepts/adaptive-large-neighborhood-sea.title: Adaptive Large Neighborhood Search for MIP (ALNS-MIP)
concepts/adaptive-large-neighborhood-sea.summary: ALNS-MIP adaptively chooses and budgets MIP neighborhood subproblems to improve incumbents within branch-and-bound.

concepts/multiple-flying-sidekicks-trave.title: Multiple Flying Sidekicks Traveling Salesman Problem (mFSTSP)
concepts/multiple-flying-sidekicks-trave.summary: mFSTSP models one truck coordinated with multiple UAVs, with launch/retrieval synchronization and payload-dependent endurance, minimizing overall completion time.

concepts/multi-objective-maritime-cargo-.title: Multi-Objective Maritime Cargo Routing and Scheduling
concepts/multi-objective-maritime-cargo-.summary: Maritime cargo route and schedule planning where makespan, freight cost, and delivery delays are optimized together, so the answer is a Pareto front a charterer can choose from.

concepts/iterated-local-search.md.title: Iterated Local Search (ILS)
concepts/iterated-local-search.md.summary: ILS: walks the reduced space of local optima by perturbing the incumbent, re-running local search, and accepting by a rule; quality hinges on perturbation strength and acceptance criterion.

concepts/leximax-leximin-fairness-princi.title: Leximax and Leximin Fairness Principles
concepts/leximax-leximin-fairness-princi.summary: Definition and properties of lexicographic maximin (leximin) and leximax orderings: Pigou-Dalton fairness axioms, fair dominance, OWA limits, alpha-fairness, water-filling, and complexity.

concepts/ratio-mean-reversion-and-contin.title: Ratio Mean Reversion and Continuing-Value Benchmarks
concepts/ratio-mean-reversion-and-contin.summary: Drivers fade toward economy-wide levels: RE rank corr. 0.55→0.18 over 5 years, RNOA var. ratio 0.127 at t=5, FLEV 0.937 at t=1 — so CV2/CV3, not CV1, are the typical case.

concepts/inverse-soft-q-imitation-learni.title: Inverse Soft-Q Imitation Learning
concepts/inverse-soft-q-imitation-learni.summary: One soft-Q function represents both reward and policy, removing the adversarial min-max; the softmax of Q is the policy and Q minus its value is the reward.

concepts/bin-packing-based-cutting-stock.title: Bin-Packing-Based Cutting Stock ILP
concepts/bin-packing-based-cutting-stock.summary: Encode cutting as 1D bin packing: pieces as items, patterns as bins, strips as item+bin; compact size-indexed-free ILP plus precedence symmetry breakers beats index models at low per-type demand.

concepts/gross-profitability-premium.md.title: Gross Profitability Premium
concepts/gross-profitability-premium.md.summary: GP/A (revenues minus COGS over book assets) predicts average returns like B/M, hedges value at correlation -0.57, and explains most earnings-related anomalies.

concepts/simulated-annealing-metropolis-.title: Simulated Annealing: Metropolis Acceptance and Cooling
concepts/simulated-annealing-metropolis-.summary: Simulated annealing as the handbook frames it: Metropolis acceptance as a probability, control-parameter cooling as the exploration dial, and acceptance-rate monitoring as the practical tuning signal.

concepts/bilevel-vrpd-task-assignment-ro.title: Bi-level VRPD Task Assignment and Routing
concepts/bilevel-vrpd-task-assignment-ro.summary: A two-level optimization pattern that separates customer-to-mode assignment from route/schedule construction in VRPD, coupling global assignment search with ALNS route refinement.

concepts/liner-shipping-network-design.m.title: Liner Shipping Network Design
concepts/liner-shipping-network-design.m.summary: The optimization problem of constructing cyclic liner services, assigning vessel capacity, and routing commodity demand under transit, transshipment, and cost constraints.

concepts/exact-multitrip-vrptw-framework.title: Exact Multitrip VRPTW Framework
concepts/exact-multitrip-vrptw-framework.summary: A structure-based exact framework for capacitated multitrip VRPs with time windows that combines lower bounds and branch-and-cut to scale better than earlier exact approaches.

concepts/mmse-covariance-shrinkage.md.title: MMSE Covariance Shrinkage
concepts/mmse-covariance-shrinkage.md.summary: Family of estimators that shrink noisy sample covariance toward a structured target to lower finite-sample MMSE, especially when dimensions are high and observations are scarce.

concepts/periodic-scheduling-under-capac.title: Periodic Scheduling Under Capacity Constraints
concepts/periodic-scheduling-under-capac.summary: Family of periodic service-allocation models with per-slot capacity limits, balancing fairness or cost via exact tree constructions and approximation guarantees.

concepts/residual-earnings-equity-valuat.title: Residual Earnings Valuation (Clean-Surplus Excess-Return Model)
concepts/residual-earnings-equity-valuat.summary: Equity value = book value + discounted residual earnings; RE_t = CNI_t − (ρ_E−1)CSE_{t−1} with clean surplus, three continuing-value rules, drivers = PM, ATO, leverage.

concepts/operating-and-financial-leverag.title: Operating and Financial Leverage Spreading (ROCE Decomposition)
concepts/operating-and-financial-leverag.summary: ROCE = RNOA + FLEV·SPREAD = PM·ATO + FLEV·SPREAD, and RNOA = ROOA + OLLEV·OLSPREAD; median 1963–1999 FLEV 0.40, OLLEV 0.35, SPREAD 3.9%, OLSPREAD 3.4%.

concepts/set-team-orienteering-problem-w.title: Set Team Orienteering Problem with Time Windows (STOPTW)
concepts/set-team-orienteering-problem-w.summary: STOPTW extends SOP/TOPTW by assigning profits to customer clusters while enforcing customer and depot time windows over multiple tours.

concepts/four-stage-guillotine-cut-bound.title: Four-stage Guillotine-cut Bounded Knapsack
concepts/four-stage-guillotine-cut-bound.summary: Exact 2D cutting/packing concept where bounded item production and four-stage guillotine cuts are solved via DP-derived hypergraph flow with strong pruning.

concepts/set-orienteering-problem.md.title: Set Orienteering Problem (SOP)
concepts/set-orienteering-problem.md.summary: SOP maximizes cluster-level profit under a route-duration budget, with both matheuristic and branch-and-cut exact strategies now defining the practical solution landscape.

concepts/statistical-investigation-lifec.title: Statistical Investigation Lifecycle
concepts/statistical-investigation-lifec.summary: End-to-end workflow for statistical problem solving: clarify the question, collect fit-for-purpose data, explore assumptions, model carefully, and communicate uncertainty.

concepts/time-space-network-ship-flow-mo.title: Time-Space Network Ship-Flow Model
concepts/time-space-network-ship-flow-mo.summary: Ship as flow commodity on a location-by-day network: path cover plus node conservation encodes the schedule, so inventory, berth limits and losses become linear constraints.

concepts/dynamic-discretization-discover.title: Dynamic Discretization Discovery
concepts/dynamic-discretization-discover.summary: Exact optimization strategy that starts with coarse time discretization and iteratively adds only the time points needed to recover continuous-time feasibility and optimality.

concepts/ordering-information-portfolio-.title: Ordering-Information Portfolio Selection
concepts/ordering-information-portfolio-.summary: Portfolio-construction paradigm that uses ranking beliefs about expected returns, rather than precise return forecasts, while retaining explicit risk controls.

concepts/cooperative-multi-agent-uav-rou.title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Routing with Shared Reward
concepts/cooperative-multi-agent-uav-rou.summary: Fleet routing where agents earn different rewards for their own versus other agents' regions; cooperation is what makes adding vehicles pay (4-agent reward 100 to 150).

concepts/fama-macbeth-two-stage-cross-se.title: Fama-MacBeth Two-Stage Cross-Sectional Regression
concepts/fama-macbeth-two-stage-cross-se.summary: The portfolio-formation plus monthly cross-sectional regression design; its template now drives profitability tests in Thailand and ASEAN markets.

concepts/hyper-heuristics.md.title: Hyper-Heuristics
concepts/hyper-heuristics.md.summary: Hyper-heuristics optimize over heuristics rather than direct solutions, mainly via heuristic selection or generation with online, offline, or no learning.

concepts/mirp-modeling-continuous-vs-dis.title: Continuous vs Discrete Time in Maritime Inventory Routing Models
concepts/mirp-modeling-continuous-vs-dis.summary: The MIRP modeling fork: a discrete time-expanded port-time node grid versus a continuous-time port-visit node grid, with the trade-offs that decide which one a study should use.

references/andersson2017-creating-annual.title: Creating annual delivery programs of liquefied natural gas
references/andersson2017-creating-annual.summary: Branch-and-cut ADP model for LNG producers balancing contract fulfillment cost and spot-market upside, strengthened with valid inequalities for tighter relaxations.

references/ksciuk2023-maritime-uncertain.title: Uncertainty in Maritime Ship Routing and Scheduling: Literature Review (Ksciuk et al., 2023)
references/ksciuk2023-maritime-uncertain.summary: Surveys uncertainty modeling in maritime routing/scheduling across strategic, tactical, and operational decisions, highlighting a major gap between academic methods and industry adoption.

references/bertsimas2022-bootstrap-robus.title: Bootstrap Robust Prescriptive Analytics
references/bertsimas2022-bootstrap-robus.summary: Adds finite-sample robustness to contextual prescriptions by combining bootstrap ambiguity sets with estimate-first-optimize-later decision rules.

references/archetti2018-set-orienteering.title: The Set Orienteering Problem
references/archetti2018-set-orienteering.summary: Foundational SOP formulation and matheuristic for maximizing cluster profit under route-duration limits, with strong solution quality on large benchmark instances.

references/tamke2023-vrpd-dss.md.title: Vehicle Routing Problem with Drones and Drone Speed Selection (Tamke & Buscher, 2023)
references/tamke2023-vrpd-dss.md.summary: Introduces VRPD-DSS with discrete drone-speed decisions and payload-aware energy costs, showing that adaptive speed choices beat constant-speed operations in truck-drone delivery.

references/dorling2017-drone-delivery-vr.title: Vehicle Routing Problems for Drone Delivery (Dorling et al., 2017)
references/dorling2017-drone-delivery-vr.summary: Adds a measured linear multirotor power model, battery weight as payload, drone reuse, and per-route battery optimization to VRP, with two Dantzig-Wolfe MILP variants and simulated annealing.

references/fama1973-risk-return-equilibr.title: Risk, Return, and Equilibrium: Empirical Tests (Fama & MacBeth, 1973)
references/fama1973-risk-return-equilibr.summary: The 1973 two-parameter CAPM test on 42 years of NYSE data: 20 beta portfolios, monthly cross-sectional regressions, beta priced, non-beta risk not, no nonlinearity.

references/raj2020multiple-variable-dron.title: The multiple flying sidekicks traveling salesman problem with variable drone speeds (Raj & Murray, 2020)
references/raj2020multiple-variable-dron.summary: mFSTSP-VDS: truck + heterogeneous UAV fleet, cruise speed a decision variable, Liu 2017 power model. Three-phase heuristic; up to 22.2% makespan savings vs max speed.

references/gronhaug2010-branch-and-price.title: A Branch-and-Price Method for a Liquefied Natural Gas Inventory Routing Problem
references/gronhaug2010-branch-and-price.summary: Branch-and-price solves LNG-IRP with boil-off, variable production, discrete tank unloading; 16/27 instances optimal, up to 25x faster than a priori path enumeration.

references/garg2022-iq-learn-inverse-sof.title: IQ-Learn: Inverse soft-Q Learning for Imitation (Garg, Chakraborty, Cundy, Song, Geist & Ermon, 2022)
references/garg2022-iq-learn-inverse-sof.summary: One soft-Q function encodes reward and policy so imitation learning needs no adversarial min-max; state-of-the-art offline/online returns, 0.99 reward correlation, and goal-shift generalization.

references/jimenez-piqueras2023-constrai.title: Constraint Programming Models for Container Pre-Marshalling
references/jimenez-piqueras2023-constrai.summary: A five-model CP series for container premarshalling: each added decision-variable group cuts solve time, and the best model beats the state-of-the-art IP on all datasets.

references/goel2015-constraint-programmi.title: Constraint Programming for LNG Ship Scheduling and Inventory Management (Goel, Slusky, van Hoeve, Furman & Shao, 2015)
references/goel2015-constraint-programmi.summary: Two CPOptimizer models on a disjunctive-scheduling representation plus cumulative-bound search; 4.55x-10.5x faster than the MIP heuristic, with better solutions.

references/christiansen2007-maritime-tra.title: Maritime Transportation OR Models Across Planning Levels (Christiansen et al., 2007)
references/christiansen2007-maritime-tra.summary: Surveys maritime transportation OR models across strategic, tactical, and operational horizons, with canonical formulations for fleet sizing, liner network design, and ship routing/scheduling.

references/ha2020-vrp-synchronization-lp.title: A New CP Model and LP-based ALNS for VRP with Synchronization Constraints
references/ha2020-vrp-synchronization-lp.summary: First MIP and CP model for VRP-SC; lp-ALNS uses LP insertion feasibility, beats cp-ALNS on all classes, finds 620 new best-known solutions, improves four VRPTWSyn bests.

references/montemanni2024-pdsvrp-collect.title: Combining Heuristics and Constraint Programming for the Parallel Drone Scheduling Vehicle Routing Problem with Collective Drones (Montemanni et al., 2024)
references/montemanni2024-pdsvrp-collect.summary: Deep-dive notes on Montemanni et al. (2024): CP-SAT models for PDSVRP-c and why truck-only VRP hint-start improves bounds and solution quality.

references/hojabri2018-vrp-synchronizati.title: ALNS + Constraint Programming for VRP with Synchronization (Hojabri et al., 2018)
references/hojabri2018-vrp-synchronizati.summary: Presents an ALNS framework with CP-based reinsertion for VRP synchronization constraints, showing robust improvements on benchmark sets.

references/al-haidous2016-optimal-lng-de.title: Optimal planning of liquefied natural gas deliveries
references/al-haidous2016-optimal-lng-de.summary: Arc-flow MIP for annual LNG delivery planning that minimizes fleet size while enforcing berth, inventory, maintenance, and bunkering constraints at industrial scale.

references/brown2007-negative-book-equit.title: Going Negative — What to Do with Negative Book Equity Stocks
references/brown2007-negative-book-equit.summary: Shows that excluding negative-book-equity stocks from value-growth sorting loses systematic return information, and proposes returns-based style classification to reintegrate them.

references/torabbeigi2020-payload-bcr-dr.title: Payload-induced Battery Consumption in Drone Delivery Scheduling (Torabbeigi et al., 2020)
references/torabbeigi2020-payload-bcr-dr.summary: Introduces payload-dependent battery-consumption modeling for drone delivery and shows that ignoring it can make planned routes infeasible.

references/li2024drone.md.title: Drone Routing Problem with Swarm Synchronization (Li, Wang & Zhan, 2024)
references/li2024drone.md.summary: DRP-SS: a VRPTW variant with drone swarms that couple and decouple at nodes, multi trips, split delivery; MILP plus ALNS with detour and multi-trip operators.

references/pisinger2019-large-neighborho.title: Large Neighborhood Search (Handbook of Metaheuristics chapter)
references/pisinger2019-large-neighborho.summary: The canonical LNS/ALNS chapter: LNS pseudocode, destroy-repair design principles, very-large-scale neighborhood classes, adaptive operator weights with roulette-wheel selection, and a survey of VRP, scheduling, and parallel-LNS applications.

references/fuertes2023-transformer-multi.title: Solving Routing Problems for Multiple Cooperative UAVs Using Transformer Networks (Fuertes et al., 2023)
references/fuertes2023-transformer-multi.summary: Two-stage multi-UAV planner: fuzzy C-means assigns regions, a trained Transformer writes the tour; near-Compass reward at 62x-229x lower inference time.

references/montemanni2023-cp-pdsvrp.md.title: Constraint Programming Models for the Parallel Drone Scheduling Vehicle Routing Problem
references/montemanni2023-cp-pdsvrp.md.summary: Two CP-SAT models per variant for min-time and min-cost PDSVRP: new best lower bounds on all tested instances, first bounds for min-cost benchmarks, several instances closed.

references/meucci2010-fully-flexible-vie.title: Fully Flexible Views: Theory and Practice
references/meucci2010-fully-flexible-vie.summary: Entropy pooling inputs an arbitrary non-normal prior plus arbitrary views/stress-tests; the posterior is the prior scenarios re-weighted by relative-entropy minimization, no repricing needed.

references/yu2024-sarl-stoptw.md.title: Simulated Annealing with Reinforcement Learning for STOPTW (Yu et al.)
references/yu2024-sarl-stoptw.md.summary: Introduces SA_RL for STOPTW and reports strong gains over CPLEX and baseline SA on large clustered time-window orienteering instances.

references/richards1996-scheduling-to-ma.title: Scheduling to Maximize Customer Satisfaction: A Project for the Shad Valley Program
references/richards1996-scheduling-to-ma.summary: Student-seminar scheduling for the Shad Valley program is a capacitated transportation problem: the total-satisfaction (sum) model can sacrifice one student, while a two-phase bottleneck (max-min) model guarantees the worst assignment.

references/ozili2017-bank-loan-loss-prov.title: Bank Loan Loss Provisions Research: A Review
references/ozili2017-bank-loan-loss-prov.summary: Post-2000 review of bank loan loss provisioning: LLP discretion links to income smoothing, capital management, signalling and procyclicality across Basel regimes and country contexts.

references/phanduc2025-pareto-front-grid.title: Pareto Front Grid Guided Multiobjective Optimization in Dynamic Pickup and Delivery with Two-Sided Fairness
references/phanduc2025-pareto-front-grid.summary: PFG-2F extends random-key Pareto-front-grid selection to a four-objective dynamic pickup-and-delivery problem (fuel, max waiting, customer fairness, vehicle fairness) and dominates NSGA-II, MOEA/D variants, and PFG-MOEA on HV and IGD over 180 Li-Lim instances.

references/gendreau2019-handbook-metaheu.title: Handbook of Metaheuristics (Gendreau & Potvin, 2019)
references/gendreau2019-handbook-metaheu.summary: Reference for the handbook's metaheuristic patterns: LNS destroy/repair, VNS neighborhood change, tabu memory, SA cooling, PSO/ACO swarms, and hybrid search.

references/gronhaug2009-supply-chain-opt.title: Supply Chain Optimization for the Liquefied Natural Gas Business
references/gronhaug2009-supply-chain-opt.summary: Coins the LNG-IRP for real tactical fleet planning; arc-flow and path-flow MIPs on 21 real-inspired instances, both optimal on small cases, path enumeration explodes at scale.

references/hadjsalem2023-2d-variable-siz.title: Mathematical Models for the Two-Dimensional Variable-Sized Cutting Stock Problem in the Home Textile Industry
references/hadjsalem2023-2d-variable-siz.summary: Four ILP models for 2D variable-sized fabric-roll cutting in home textile; BPP-based ILP-4+S solves 97/160 instances in ~10 s avg; ε-constraint gives exact Pareto textile-vs-patterns fronts.

references/idzorek20072-bl-confidence-le.title: A Step-by-Step Guide to the Black-Litterman Model: Incorporating User-Specified Confidence Levels
references/idzorek20072-bl-confidence-le.summary: Practical Black-Litterman recipe: implied confidence from the 100%-certainty case, then Ω diagonal entries solved to reproduce user-specified 0-100% confidence tilts.

references/christiansen2008-maritime-inv.title: Maritime Inventory Routing Problems (Christiansen & Fagerholt, 2008)
references/christiansen2008-maritime-inv.summary: Defines the basic maritime inventory routing problem (ISRP) and its main extensions, integrating ship routing/scheduling with inventory dynamics at production and consumption ports.

references/fagerholt2023-maritime-invent.title: Maritime Inventory Routing: Recent Trends and Future Directions (Fagerholt et al., 2023)
references/fagerholt2023-maritime-invent.summary: Decade survey of 53 MIRP papers: what makes maritime IRP unlike land IRP, discrete vs continuous time trade-offs, solution-method census, benchmarks, directions.

references/furini2016-two-dimensional-gu.title: Modeling Two-Dimensional Guillotine Cutting Problems via Integer Programming (Furini, Malaguti & Thomopulos, 2016)
references/furini2016-two-dimensional-gu.summary: Plate-and-cut-position MIP over all feasible guillotine cuts plus variable pricing solves 16 of 21 large instances to optimality where the plain model solved none.

references/he2002-black-litterman-intuit.title: The Intuition Behind Black-Litterman Model Portfolios
references/he2002-black-litterman-intuit.summary: The unconstrained Black-Litterman optimal portfolio is the market equilibrium scaled for equilibrium-return uncertainty plus weighted view portfolios, weights rising with bullishness and confidence.

references/montemanni2024-parallel-colle.title: Parallel Drone Scheduling Vehicle Routing Problems with Collective Drones
references/montemanni2024-parallel-colle.summary: First CP/MILP treatment of PDSVRP with collective drones: a workload-balancing valid inequality plus CP1-CP3 models give first-ever lower bounds on all PDSTSP-c and PDSVRP-c instances.

references/christiansen2020-liner-shippi.title: Liner Shipping Network Design Survey (Christiansen et al., 2020)
references/christiansen2020-liner-shippi.summary: A comprehensive LSNDP survey that formalizes service design, fleet deployment, and commodity flow integration, and compares four main algorithm families against LINER-LIB benchmarks.

references/ball2016-accruals-cash-flows-.title: Accruals, cash flows, and operating profitability in the cross section of stock returns
references/ball2016-accruals-cash-flows-.summary: Shows cash-based operating profitability predicts stock returns better than accrual-inclusive profitability and largely subsumes the accrual anomaly in cross-sectional tests.

references/black1992-global-portfolio-op.title: Global Portfolio Optimization
references/black1992-global-portfolio-op.summary: Uses CAPM equilibrium returns as a neutral prior and blends investor views by confidence, yielding more stable global asset-allocation portfolios than naive mean assumptions.

references/halvorsen-weare2013-lng-routi.title: Routing and Scheduling in a Liquefied Natural Gas Shipping Problem with Inventory and Berth Constraints
references/halvorsen-weare2013-lng-routi.summary: Decomposes annual LNG delivery planning into subproblem routing models and a feasibility scheduling MILP coupled only by berth and inventory constraints; heuristic routing scales to 360-day horizons.

references/goel2012-large-neighborhood-s.title: Large Neighborhood Search for LNG Inventory Routing (Goel, Furman, Song & El-Bakry, 2012)
references/goel2012-large-neighborhood-s.summary: 1-year LNG inventory-routing arc-flow MIP; greedy construction plus time-window and two-ship large-neighborhood heuristics beat CPLEX 11.1 on hard instances, up to 15.7x geometric-mean speedup.

references/boland2017-dynamic-discretiza.title: Solving the TSPTW with Dynamic Discretization Discovery
references/boland2017-dynamic-discretiza.summary: Presents Dynamic Discretization Discovery for TSPTW, iteratively refining only needed departure times and solving many benchmark instances to optimality with much smaller networks.

references/novy-marx2013-other-side-of-v.title: The Other Side of Value: The Gross Profitability Premium
references/novy-marx2013-other-side-of-v.summary: Novy-Marx (JFE 2013): gross profits-to-assets predicts returns like B/M, hedges value, and a four-factor model cuts anomaly pricing error to 0.22% per month.

references/cheng2020-drone-routing-energ.title: Drone Routing with Nonlinear Energy Function (Cheng et al.)
references/cheng2020-drone-routing-energ.summary: Formulates multi-trip drone routing with nonlinear payload-dependent energy and solves it via branch-and-cut with logical and subgradient cuts.

references/morandi2024-orienteering-prob.title: The Orienteering Problem with Drones (Morandi, Leus & Yaman, 2024)
references/morandi2024-orienteering-prob.summary: Morandi, Leus & Yaman define the OP-mD (truck + battery-limited drones, prize-collecting) and solve it with a compact MILP, separation scheme, valid inequalities and symmetry breaking.

references/lu2024-hybrid-evolutionary-al.title: Hybrid Evolutionary Algorithm for the Set Orienteering Problem (Lu et al.)
references/lu2024-hybrid-evolutionary-al.summary: Presents a hybrid evolutionary algorithm for SOP with cluster-aware crossover and two-phase local refinement, reporting strong benchmark performance.

references/bar-noy2002-minimizing-period.title: Minimizing Service and Operation Costs of Periodic Scheduling
references/bar-noy2002-minimizing-period.summary: Defines a generalized periodic-scheduling model balancing service and operating costs, proves hardness, and gives strong approximation algorithms with nonlinear-relaxation bounds.

references/bertsimas2020-predictive-to-p.title: From Predictive to Prescriptive Analytics
references/bertsimas2020-predictive-to-p.summary: Introduces a contextual decision framework that converts predictive features into optimized prescriptions and evaluates value with the coefficient of prescriptiveness.

references/murray2020-multiple-flying-si.title: Multiple Flying Sidekicks Traveling Salesman Problem (Murray & Raj, 2020)
references/murray2020-multiple-flying-si.summary: Defines mFSTSP for one truck with multiple heterogeneous drones and proposes a three-phase heuristic with timing MILP to solve practical-scale instances.

references/isik2023-constraint-programmi.title: Constraint Programming Models for Hybrid Flow Shop Scheduling
references/isik2023-constraint-programmi.summary: First CP models for blocked and SDST hybrid flow shops with unrelated machines and eligibility; CP beats two new MILP models on all instance sizes.

references/lourenco2019iterated.md.title: Iterated Local Search: Framework and Applications (Lourenço, Martin & Stützle, 2019)
references/lourenco2019iterated.md.summary: Handbook chapter defining ILS: walk over local optima via perturbation + acceptance; design rules for the four modules, speed advantage, applications, relations to other metaheuristics.

references/christiansen2013-ship-routing.title: Ship Routing and Scheduling in the New Millennium (Christiansen et al., 2013)
references/christiansen2013-ship-routing.summary: Fourth instalment of the ship routing survey series, covering 2002-2011: four basic models, liner network design and fleet deployment, and evidence that papers and outlets double each decade.

references/paradiso2020-esf-multitrip-vr.title: Exact Solution Framework for Multitrip VRP with Time Windows (Paradiso et al., 2020)
references/paradiso2020-esf-multitrip-vr.summary: Proposes a structure-based exact framework (ESF) for multitrip VRP with time windows, combining strong lower bounds and branch-and-cut to solve larger instances than prior exact methods.

references/hendel2022-adaptive-lns-for-m.title: Adaptive Large Neighborhood Search for Mixed Integer Programming (Hendel, 2022)
references/hendel2022-adaptive-lns-for-m.summary: Adaptive LNS for mixed integer programs: bandit-selected destroy and repair operators that improve primal heuristics inside SCIP.

references/ganjia2026-multiobjective-sus.title: Multi-Objective Sustainable Supply Chain Scheduling (Ganjia, Rabet, Sajadi & Daneshvar Kakhki, 2026)
references/ganjia2026-multiobjective-sus.summary: Bi-objective MINLP coupling scheduling, due dates, batch delivery and heterogeneous VRP with time windows; Taguchi-tuned NSGA-II beats MOPSO with gaps below 0.8%.

references/deshpande2023-lng-adp-invento.title: Optimal LNG ADP with Customer Inventory and Berth Management (Deshpande et al., 2023)
references/deshpande2023-lng-adp-invento.summary: Profit-maximizing LNG annual delivery model that adds explicit customer inventory and berth constraints, showing these constraints prevent operationally infeasible ADPs.

references/boland2017-continuous-time-se.title: The Continuous-Time Service Network Design Problem
references/boland2017-continuous-time-se.summary: Introduces an iterative partially time-expanded network method that reaches continuous-time optimal service-network design solutions without building the full minute-level network.

references/archetti2023-branch-and-cut-s.title: A new formulation and a branch-and-cut algorithm for the set orienteering problem
references/archetti2023-branch-and-cut-s.summary: Exact SOP branch-and-cut with a lower-variable formulation and new cut families, reaching state-of-the-art performance on benchmark instances up to 100 customers.

references/ha2018-min-cost-tsp-d.md.title: Min-cost Traveling Salesman Problem with Drone (Ha et al., 2018)
references/ha2018-min-cost-tsp-d.md.summary: Defines min-cost TSP-D with transportation and waiting penalties, and shows split-based GRASP consistently beats TSP-LS in cost quality with acceptable runtime.

references/guo2018-generative-adversaria.title: Generative Adversarial Self-Imitation Learning
references/guo2018-generative-adversaria.summary: GASIL: the agent adversarially imitates its own top-K past trajectories; the learned discriminator becomes a shaped reward r − alpha·log D added to policy-gradient updates.

references/murray2015flying.md.title: The flying sidekick traveling salesman problem: Optimization of drone-assisted parcel delivery (Murray & Chu, 2015)
references/murray2015flying.md.summary: FSTSP: truck+UAV tandem with 3-node sortie triples, 32-constraint MILP, route-and-re-assign heuristic; PDSTSP: depot-launched UAV fleet. Gaps 0.12–10.68% on 720 instances.

references/nguyen2022-min-cost-pdsvrp.md.title: The Min-cost Parallel Drone Scheduling Vehicle Routing Problem (Nguyen et al., 2022)
references/nguyen2022-min-cost-pdsvrp.md.summary: Introduces the min-cost PDSVRP, a MILP and SISSRs heuristic, with strong performance on instances up to 400 customers and state-of-the-art PDSTSP adaptation.

references/chatfield1995-problem-solving.title: Problem Solving — A Statistician's Guide (2nd ed.)
references/chatfield1995-problem-solving.summary: Practical statistics handbook emphasizing end-to-end problem solving: framing questions, collecting and exploring data, choosing robust analyses, and communicating results.

references/liu2017power.md.title: A Power Consumption Model for Multi-Rotor Small Unmanned Aircraft Systems (Liu, Sengupta & Kurzhanskiy, 2017)
references/liu2017power.md.summary: Multi-rotor power model: induced, profile, parasite components from helicopter theory; parameters identified by hover, ascend/descend, cruise tests; 2-17% validation error.

references/dinh2021-haco-pdstsp.md.title: Hybrid Ant Colony Optimization for PDSTSP (Dinh et al., 2021)
references/dinh2021-haco-pdstsp.md.summary: HACO metaheuristic for PDSTSP using dual pheromone trails and a fast split-by-DP decoder, outperforming prior PDSTSP metaheuristics on benchmark classes.

references/bar-noy2004-efficient-algorit.title: Efficient algorithms for periodic scheduling
references/bar-noy2004-efficient-algorit.summary: Studies perfectly periodic scheduling under fairness objectives, proving NP-hardness and combining optimal exponential methods with practical tree-scheduling heuristics.

references/meng2023-multivisit-drone-pic.title: Multi-Visit Drone Routing Problem for Pickup and Delivery (MDRP-PD)
references/meng2023-multivisit-drone-pic.summary: MDRP-PD: K truck-drone pairs serve pickup-and-delivery customers at minimum truck distance + load-dependent drone energy cost; the MP-ISA heuristic is near-exact on small instances.

references/asghari2021-green-vrp-state-o.title: Green vehicle routing problem: A state-of-the-art review
references/asghari2021-green-vrp-state-o.summary: Systematic review of Green-VRP literature (2000–2020) that organizes ICEV, AFV, and HEV streams into a unified taxonomy of models, objectives, and methods.

references/kakinuma2020-empirical-profit.title: Empirical Profitability Anomalies in Thailand
references/kakinuma2020-empirical-profit.summary: In Thailand 2002-2019 gross profit and cash-flow-to-price profitability predict returns; top quintiles beat the market Sharpe, operating income alone does not.

references/papageorgiou2014-mirplib-mirp.title: MIRPLib – A Library of Maritime Inventory Routing Problem Instances: Survey, Core Model, and Benchmark Results
references/papageorgiou2014-mirplib-mirp.summary: First public deep-sea MIRP benchmark library: arc-flow MILP core model on a time-space network, a 29-paper survey, unified bound techniques, and best-known gaps for 38 instance sets.

references/pham2023-efficient-ga-quadrat.title: An Efficient Hybrid Genetic Algorithm for the Quadratic Traveling Salesman Problem
references/pham2023-efficient-ga-quadrat.summary: A biased-fitness genetic algorithm with a restricted double-bridge local search finds new best-known solutions on 437 of 450 quadratic TSP benchmark instances and closes the gap to the state-of-the-art matheuristic at every tested size.

references/nguyen2023-pdstsp-collective-.title: The Parallel Drone Scheduling Traveling Salesman Problem with Collective Drones (Nguyen & Hà, 2023)
references/nguyen2023-pdstsp-collective-.summary: Nguyen & Hà define PDSTSP-c, where coupled depot drones serve heavy parcels; two-index flow MILP + RnR with a DAG topological-sort move evaluation; 23.47% average gain.

references/clautiaux2018-hypergraph-guil.title: Combining Dynamic Programming and Lagrangian Filtering for Four-stage 2D Guillotine Bounded Knapsack (Clautiaux et al., 2018)
references/clautiaux2018-hypergraph-guil.summary: Exact hypergraph-flow and dynamic-programming framework for four-stage guillotine bounded knapsack, accelerated by preprocessing and Lagrangian filtering.

references/ledoit2004wellconditioned.md.title: A Well-Conditioned Estimator for Large-Dimensional Covariance Matrices
references/ledoit2004wellconditioned.md.summary: Ledoit & Wolf (2004): explicit linear shrinkage of the sample covariance toward the identity, asymptotically optimal under Frobenius loss, invertible and better-conditioned, even when p > n.

references/nguyen2025set.md.title: The set team orienteering problem (Nguyen, Martinelli, Pham & Hà, 2025)
references/nguyen2025set.md.summary: STOP: vehicle-routing with clusters and cluster-level profits. Branch-and-price proves optimal for STOP up to 783 nodes/157 clusters; LNS 595/612 SOP best-known, 40 new, 61.9% SOP instances optimal.

references/mbiadousaleu2022parallel.md.title: The parallel drone scheduling problem with multiple drones and vehicles (Mbiadou Saleu, Deroussi, Feillet, Grangeon & Quilliot, 2022)
references/mbiadousaleu2022parallel.md.summary: PDSMTSP: K trucks, M drones in parallel, completion-time objective. Branch-and-cut fails in 3 h; ILS with dynamic-programming split of a giant tour beats B&C on 13 CVRPLIB instances, n = 50-199.

references/nissim2001-ratio-analysis-equ.title: Ratio Analysis and Equity Valuation: From Research to Practice
references/nissim2001-ratio-analysis-equ.summary: Nissim & Penman (Review of Accounting Studies 2001): ratio analysis rebuilt from accounting-based valuation, then documented 1963–1999 medians, correlations and fade rates.

references/poikonen2020-k-mvdrp.md.title: Multi-visit Drone Routing Problem (Poikonen & Golden, 2020)
references/poikonen2020-k-mvdrp.md.summary: Introduces k-MVDRP and an RTS heuristic for truck-multi-drone routing with weight-aware energy limits, showing major sensitivity to drone speed, fleet size, and battery assumptions.

references/hartman2023-leximin-approxima.title: Leximin Approximation: From Single-Objective to Multi-Objective
references/hartman2023-leximin-approxima.summary: Polynomial-time algorithm converts any (α,ε)-approximate single-objective solver into an (α²/(1−α+α²), ε/(1−α+α²))-leximin approximation, independent of the number of objectives.

references/almgren2004-optimal-portfolio.title: Optimal Portfolios from Ordering Information
references/almgren2004-optimal-portfolio.summary: Extends Markowitz selection to cases with only return-ordering beliefs, using cone-based preference geometry and efficient algorithms for risk-constrained portfolio construction.

references/ku2016-mixed-integer-programm.title: Mixed Integer Programming for the Job Shop Scheduling Problem
references/ku2016-mixed-integer-programm.summary: Benchmarking four classic JSP MIP models in CPLEX, GUROBI, SCIP and against CP: Manne's disjunctive model wins in CPLEX/GUROBI, CP dominates large instances.

references/chen2010-shrinkage-mmse-covar.title: Shrinkage Algorithms for MMSE Covariance Estimation
references/chen2010-shrinkage-mmse-covar.summary: Develops RBLW and OAS shrinkage estimators for covariance matrices in small-sample high-dimensional regimes, improving MMSE behavior over classical Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage.

references/ogryczak2014-fair-optimizatio.title: Fair Optimization and Networks: A Survey
references/ogryczak2014-fair-optimizatio.summary: Survey of inequality-averse fair optimization: fair-dominance axioms, OWA and alpha-fairness aggregations, lexicographic maximin algorithms, price-of-fairness bounds for networks and location.

references/kim2020-profitability-asean-s.title: Operating Profitability and Expected Stock Returns in ASEAN Markets
references/kim2020-profitability-asean-s.summary: Operating profitability (OP/book equity and OP/book assets) raises expected stock returns across ASEAN markets 2010-2019; factor-adjusted decile spreads are significant.

references/dellamico2020-matheuristics-p.title: Matheuristic Algorithms for PDSTSP (Dell'Amico et al., 2020)
references/dellamico2020-matheuristics-p.summary: Introduces a simplified branch-and-cut MILP and Fast/RRLS matheuristics for PDSTSP, proving optimality on all 20-customer instances and improving many large-instance best-known solutions.

references/beatty2014-financial-accounti.title: Financial Accounting in the Banking Industry — Empirical Literature Review
references/beatty2014-financial-accounti.summary: Survey of bank-accounting evidence on valuation relevance, discretionary reporting, and real effects of accounting regimes, with emphasis on crisis-period policy and identification limits.

references/haug2023-adp-speed-optimizati.title: Planning LNG Annual Delivery Programs with Speed Optimization and Multiple Loading Ports
references/haug2023-adp-speed-optimizati.summary: Time-space-network MIP for the LNG annual delivery program adding vessel speed optimization and multiple loading ports; gaps below 1% within 1 hour for horizons up to 180 days.

references/meucci2006-beyond-black-litte.title: Beyond Black-Litterman in Practice: A Five-Step Recipe to Input Views on Non-Normal Markets
references/meucci2006-beyond-black-litte.summary: COP extends Black-Litterman to non-normal markets by opinion-pooling marginal views and inheriting the prior copula; a five-step Monte Carlo recipe runs all steps in a fraction of a second.

references/dossantos2024-multiobjective-.title: Multi-Objective Maritime Cargo Routing and Scheduling (dos Santos & Borenstein, 2024)
references/dossantos2024-multiobjective-.summary: MILP for multi-objective bulk-carrier cargo routing with time windows, draft limits and split loads, solved by fuzzy max-min scalarization plus two heuristics.

references/pincus2007-accrual-anomaly-in.title: The Accrual Anomaly — International Evidence
references/pincus2007-accrual-anomaly-in.summary: Across 20 countries and 62,027 firm-years, the accrual anomaly concentrates in common-law markets (Australia, Canada, UK, US) plus the ADR market, is associated with extensive accrual accounting and dispersed ownership, and is best explained by earnings management plus limits to arbitrage.

references/rakke2011rolling-rolling-hori.title: A rolling horizon heuristic for creating a liquefied natural gas annual delivery program (Rakke et al., 2011)
references/rakke2011rolling-rolling-hori.summary: Rolling horizon heuristic for the LNG annual delivery program: MIP over a priori scheduled voyages, central+forecasting windows, SSR, improvement heuristic; 10.33% avg gap.

references/barnhart1998-branch-and-price.title: Branch-and-Price: Column Generation for Solving Huge Integer Programs
references/barnhart1998-branch-and-price.summary: Canonical branch-and-price framework that embeds column generation inside branch-and-bound to solve massive set-partitioning and assignment models with stronger LP bounds.

references/ahmadi-javid2022-drone-delive.title: Delivery by Drones with Arbitrary Energy Consumption Models: A New Formulation Approach
references/ahmadi-javid2022-drone-delive.summary: Arc-based multi-trip drone-delivery formulation with arbitrary energy models, preserving nonlinear realism while substantially accelerating exact optimization on benchmarks.

references/mutlu2016-lng-annual-delivery.title: Annual LNG Delivery Program for Upstream Supply Chain (Mutlu et al., 2016)
references/mutlu2016-lng-annual-delivery.summary: Integrates LNG production, inventory, fleet routing, penalties and spot sales into an annual delivery program MIP; the vessel routing heuristic is 20.1% cheaper than 24-hour CPLEX.

references/qian2001-conditional-distribu.title: Conditional Distribution in Portfolio Theory
references/qian2001-conditional-distribu.summary: Conditional-distribution regression adjusts mean and covariance from views; the mean result matches Black-Litterman, covariance is the new result, and Theorem 2 limits weight changes to viewed assets.

references/yang2022-vrpd-bilevel-heurist.title: Solving Vehicle Routing with Drones via Bi-level Heuristic (Yang et al., 2022)
references/yang2022-vrpd-bilevel-heurist.summary: Introduces a bi-level VRPD heuristic that combines BSO assignment and ALNS routing to reduce customer waiting time in multi-truck, multi-station drone delivery.
